evidence.name: Screen field: Thickness of the label text
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Thickness of the label text" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Thickness of the label text
sections.description: How heavy the selection label looks, from 300 (Light) to 900 (Black); default 400 (Regular). Use 600-700 (Semibold/Bold) to make the chosen value read as a clear confirmation, or keep it at 400 if it should sit quietly above the wheels. Match it to the weight of your other body text for a consistent look.
